caption:
Charity that grows: one grain, seven ears, a hundred grains in each.

In this verse, those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah are compared to a grain that sprouts seven ears, each ear bearing a hundred grains. Read it slowly this evening and think about what you give.

Surah Al-Baqara 2:261

Name one small act of giving you can do before this week ends.

#sadaqah #charity #quranreflection #surahbaqarah
alt_text: The likeness of those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah is like a grain that sprouts seven ears, each ear bearing a hundred grains. And Allah gives multiple [rewards] for whom He wills. And Allah is All-Encompassing, All-Knowing (Surah Al-Baqara 2:261)
